data.name: Good Gaijin, Bad Gaijin
data.detailed_description:
A Stranger in a Strange Land

You’ve just landed in Japan. The lights are bright, the rules are unwritten, and every interaction is a crossroads. Will you blend into the harmony of the local culture, or will you be the spark that disrupts it?

In this cinematic adventure, you aren't just watching a story—you are living it. Every nod, every word, and every social cue matters.

Master the "Gaijin" Experience

Whether you’re navigating a quiet neighborhood in Kyushu or the neon-soaked streets of a metropolis, your "Gaijin Skills" will be put to the test. Will you be the respectful guest everyone welcomes back, or the outsider who plays by their own rules?

Key Features:

  • Consequence-Driven Narrative: Your choices aren't just flavor. Every decision ripples through the story, affecting how NPCs treat you and which paths remain open.

  • Authentic Japanese Atmosphere: Explore detailed environments that capture the unique "liminal" beauty of Japan, from bustling convenience stores to serene temples.

  • The "Honor" System: Balance your reputation. Being a "Good Gaijin" earns trust and secrets, while being a "Bad Gaijin" might get you into places—and trouble—you never expected.

  • Cinematic FMV Style: Experience a high-fidelity visual journey that blurs the line between film and gaming.

data.short_description: You’ve just landed in Japan with nothing but a suitcase and a lot to learn. Navigate cultural minefields, engage with a cast of local characters, and decide what kind of visitor you want to be. Part social simulator, part cinematic journey—it’s time to choose your own adventure.
